'''Petra Anhill''' is a strongman in [[Valan Luca]]'s [[Valan Luca's Traveling Show|Traveling Show]]. He is married to [[Clarine Anhill]].{{ref/book|5|25}}

==Appearance==
Petra Anhill is a muscular man with arms like tree trunks.{{ref/book|5|17}} He is shorter than [[Matrim Cauthon]], but twice as wide.{{ref/book|10|2}}

==Activities==
==={{Ne|999}}===
When [[Elayne Trakand]], [[Nynaeve al'Meara]], [[Thomdril Merrilin]] and [[Juilin Sandar]] join Luca's show, Luca introduces them to the Anhills.{{ref/book|5|17}} Petra breaks up a fight between [[Latelle Luca|Latelle]] and Nynaeve, carrying Latelle back to her wagon.{{ref/book|5|24}} Petra later has to break up a fight between [[Cerandin]] and Nynaeve.{{ref/book|5|33}} As the show enters [[Samara]], Petra is one of the people who performs in front of the circus to bring in patrons.{{ref/book|5|36}} In addition to his successful showings,{{ref/book|5|37}} Petra also performs chores around the circus.{{ref/book|5|47}} When Elayne and Nynaeve leave the show, Petra offers to escort them to the ''[[Riverserpent]]''.{{ref/book|5|48}}

==={{Ne|1000}}===
Petra and Clarine are still with the circus when [[Matrim Cauthon]] and his group join Luca.{{ref/book|10|2}} [[Jameine]], another performer, has two men fighting over her, but Petra stops the scuffle, showing a propensity for breaking up fights.{{ref/book|10|3}} When [[Seanchan]] soldiers try to bully their way into the circus near [[Jurador]], Petra, [[Bollin]], Luca and others of the show's men stand their ground.{{ref/book|11|7}} Before leaving the show, Mat gives Petra and Clarine a purse of gold so that they can eventually retire and buy an inn.{{ref/book|10|2}}{{ref/book|11|25}}

At some point Petra returns to Ebou Dar and becomes a [[Seanchan]] guard.  He is guarding the gate into [[Ebou Dar]] when Mat returns to the city.{{ref/book|14|11}}
